edit_checks.name: AE start date after end date
edit_checks.description: Raises an error when the AE start date is later than the AE end date.

edit_checks.name: Serious AE missing criteria
edit_checks.description: Raises a query when a serious AE has no seriousness criterion.

edit_checks.name: Heart rate outside expected range
edit_checks.description: Raises a warning when heart rate is below 30 or above 220 bpm.

edit_checks.name: Subject identifier format
edit_checks.description: Raises an error when the subject identifier does not match ABC-0001 format.
